text: Hello everyone, welcome to my class.In the previous periods, we have learned a story about the conflict between neighbors.Social interactions do bring trouble sometimes, but the lack of interpersonal communication might be worse.Today, we are going to dig into the problem of loneliness in the summary writing section.By the end of this lesson, you are expected to, first, identify the structure and the general idea of this article by analyzing key information development.Then, draw and integrate the key points of each paragraph by reading and analyzing the text.Finally, complete the summary and modify the first draft under teacher's guidance and peer comments.To begin with, I have a question for you.What is a summary?Let's look at the directions of summary writing from the college entrance examination in Shanghai.Let's read it together.Directions.Read the following passage.Summarize the main idea and the main points of the passage in no more than 60 words.So, from the directions, we can see that summary is a reading-based writing, focusing on the gist, points, and paraphrasing.Now, do you have a general understanding of summary?Let's have a try.Please get your worksheet ready, and you will see this article.Read this passage very quickly and tell me, what does the text mainly tell us about, and how is it organized?Yes, you're quite right.It's about causes for shyness.I guess some of you might have located the key words in the very beginning and the first sentence of each paragraph, which always tell a lot about the main idea.And grasping the main idea is the first step to join a summary for a long article.But can you be more specific about the courses?Good, you got it.They are environmental courses, like home and family life, culture and technology.Have you noticed that the information develops in a certain order?What is that?We call that general to specific pattern.Now, let's read more carefully and underline the key points.You will be given three minutes.Let's go.OK, have you finished reading?Let me show you an example.In the first paragraph, I think these might be the most important information the writer wants to convey.Do you agree?But we need to put it into a short sentence, maybe like shyness is widespread and there are three environmental causes for it.Now it's your turn to have a try to pick out the key points of the second paragraph.Maybe you have underlined some of these words and phrases.Of course, we need to put them into a concise version.For example, smaller families and fewer relatives are similar in meaning, so we just need to choose one of them.And we can shorten parents who work full time into working parents, busy parents or occupied parents by flexibly change the part of speech and the sentence pattern.And the most important step is to find the logic between these key points and try to link them up, like smaller family with busy parents deprives children of the chances to gain social experience and skills.Well, let's focus on the third paragraph.Read it more carefully and tell me what do you want to cover?Hmm, some of you might have noticed that paragraph three is mainly about an example.Here is a question.Do we include example in summary writing?My suggestion is that you touch it by referring to the key points like these and then put them into one sentence.In countries like Japan, individuals are to blame for faults, so people tend to be reserved.Is it better?When it comes to the fourth paragraph, a typical controversy appears.Shall we include data in the summary?Actually, it's not necessary.As long as we can grasp the information supported by the statistics, there is no need to write about the data.With other key points, we may summarize paragraph four as technology also accounts for the worsening shyness because technological advance reduces face-to-face interactions.Finally, we arrive at the last paragraph.But if you are careful enough, it's not difficult to find that the last paragraph repeats the key information of the first paragraph.So, there are not many new points to cover here, and we don't need to write about it again.Up till now, we have located most of the key points by analyzing each paragraph in detail, and we have also paraphrased them into four key sentences.To make it better, we need to add some linking devices to make the writing coherent.Then we generally count the number of words to ensure that it meets the requirement.Perfect!Now you have learned the three tips for a good summary writing.It's your turn to put them into practice.You will be given three minutes to write down your own summary of this passage.Are you ready?Well, time is up.Now, if you have a cell phone at hand, you may take a photo of your writing and send it to me.You will have another two minutes to share and make comments.Okay, I guess you have received many valuable comments from your peers.Let's take a look at two students' drafts.First, let's focus on the structure.Do they stick to the organization of general to specific?Yes, they are.But there is a difference between your choices of transitional words.So which one do you prefer?The second one.Oh, it's more natural and fluent when you use also, finally, compared to first, second, and third.So, to achieve a coherent summary writing, we should make it flow.Now, let's pay attention to the content.Is there some room for improvement here?Oh, you might think that the red sentences here are not exactly right.So what is the correct understanding?For the first student's work, maybe technology just reduces the chances for personal contact instead of replacing people.Do you think so?And for the second student's work, yeah, smaller family is the first course but not the most important one according to the original text.Do remember, the content should not be over-interpreted in summary writing.Try to be objective and non-judgmental.As for language, similar meaning can be expressed in different ways, like what have been highlighted in green.But obviously, the simpler, the better.So, choose diverse expression to convey more information with less words.Now, we have the three tips enriched by paying attention to its fluency, objectivity, and diversity.But as we all know, a good writing is only achieved by polishing again and again.So, based on the comments from your peers and teacher, try to modify your first draft by referring to the three tips.You will be given two minutes.OK, time is limited, let's check the second version of the previous two summaries.For the first student summary, do you think the linking words are more natural?Yes, the information is more exact, of course.The expressions are different and more concise.But sure, how about the second student summary?It's better too, right?Now let's have a quick review of what we have learned today.We have read an article about the environmental courses for shyness.And guided by the structure of general to specific,we analyzed its key points paragraph by paragraphand finally completed a summary by reading, writing, sharing, commenting and modifying.Actually, summary is widely applied in our daily lives.But in various forms.A summary can be an introduction of a scenic spot,a review of a movie,an outline of a story,a profile for a company,a synopsis of a book,a personal resume,an abstract of a paper, or even more creatively, a short video recording an important event.Today we have learned the definition, writing tips and wide application of summary.To put theory into practice, your homework will be write a summary for another article about shyness,based on the skills and principles we have learned today.And pay attention to the daily application of summary writingand share one special summary with your peers.That's all for today's lesson.Bye bye.MING PAO CANADA www.
